periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axes are oriented diagonally at approximately 45 degrees, slanting downward toward the medial plane of the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with the vertical dimension elongated relative to the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: A pronounced downward taper is visible, with the lower margin narrowing towards the snout.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A distinct gap exists between the pinnae, estimated at roughly 1.5 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Top boundaries exhibit a smooth, semicircular curvature without flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: The fur typically described as white possesses a prominent tan or light-brownish hue across the cranial and dorsal regions.
